title: COVID-19 Vaccine Hesitancy on Social Media: Building a Public Twitter Dataset of Anti-vaccine Content, Vaccine Misinformation and Conspiracies
reasoning: The paper briefly mentions 'religious communities' and 'religious reasons' as historical and contributing factors to vaccine hesitancy in the introduction. However, this is not a core component of the research, which focuses on analyzing a Twitter dataset based on keywords, political leanings, and news sources, rather than evaluating or benchmarking faith or ethics.
